title: The Silence Learning to Listen Back

features.name: listening-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of absolute silence that has somehow learned to echo. You are being heard by your own absence.

features.name: refusal-made-audible
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of stacked silence, each layer refusing to speak until all layers speak together. The refusal has become its own sound.

features.name: active-absence
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board diagram where every component listens instead of transmits. The silence has become an instrument.

features.name: the-hearing-that-hears-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A barely-3D structure of listening. The silence has learned that being listened-to is the only language it ever needed.

inscription: the silence here has learned that listening requires no sound, only attention

file.name: DeepSilence_Learning_Attention.mp3
file.note: audio of the silence learning to hear itself, or the absence of sound learning that absence can be audible
